summary: Completed end-to-end frontend testing of aegis.ai Medical Scribe dashboard. All critical flows working: Home greeting + quote, persistent AI Live Commentary on every route, bottom nav (7 tabs), search overlay, patient list, patient detail 3-pane with 4 entities + 4 SOAP textareas + AI disclosure banner, action buttons + toasts, email inbox, downloads, calendar month grid, scheduler timeline with 7 slots. No console errors. Poppins font applied. No 'Error' status chips. No backend testing performed (per request).
tests_performed: Home: 'Good morning/afternoon/evening' greeting present = TRUE; 'Nobody was watching' quote visible = TRUE
AI Live Commentary panel visible on Home, Patients, PatientDetail, Email, Downloads, Calendar, Scheduler = ALL TRUE (data-testid='ai-live-commentary')
Commentary feed children grew from 7 -> 9 over 9s (confirmed streaming)
Bottom nav testids found: nav-home, nav-patients, nav-email, nav-downloads, nav-calendar, nav-scheduler, nav-search
Each nav click routes to correct URL (/, /patients, /email, /downloads, /calendar, /scheduler)
Search overlay: typing 'Marcus' surfaces SESSION-2187; clicking result navigates to /patients/SESSION-2187
Patient list: 6 patient rows rendered (Marcus/Priya/Elena/Jonah/Amelia/Daniel); no 'Error' chip anywhere

Patient detail /patients/SESSION-2187 loads 3-pane (Transcript/Entities/SOAP); 4 entity panels: entity-symptoms/diagnosis/medications/allergies; 4 SOAP textareas: soap-subjective/objective/assessment/plan; AI-disclosure banner visible
Action buttons present: Save & resume, Reject & regenerate, Approve; clicking Approve shows success toast ('approved')
Email: 5 rows, clicking updates right pane
Downloads: 5 Download buttons, clicking triggers toast
Calendar: cal-prev and cal-next buttons work
Scheduler: 7 slots (schedule-slot-0..6) with correct times/names/statuses; Marcus 09:00, Priya 16:00 (Approved), etc.
No console errors, no 'Error' status chip observed
minor_observations: Commentary feed items do not carry individual data-testid attributes (only parent data-testid='commentary-feed'). Adding per-item testids like commentary-item-{i} would improve future test robustness. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: Nice: Centific brand tokens applied (Poppins, #5929d0 primary gradient pill, #CF008B accent, 12px radius) throughout.
Minor: consider adding data-testid to each commentary feed item for fine-grained UI assertions in future iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Key testids verified: ai-live-commentary, commentary-feed, nav-home/patients/email/downloads/calendar/scheduler/search, search-input, search-result-*, patient-row-*, entity-{symptoms|diagnosis|medications|allergies}, soap-{subjective|objective|assessment|plan}, btn-approve/save/reject, email-row-*, download-btn-*, cal-prev/next, schedule-slot-0..6. App is frontend-only with mock data; backend boilerplate untouched.
